answer: One defense: bind voting power to staked capital, not to identity count - influence is strictly proportional to POA locked, so spawning clones adds zero weight and the whole sybil tactic rots like untreated timber. An attacker cannot win by multiplying puppets along the horizon; it must out-stake the honest float. To outvote 1,000 honest voters each locking 500 POA = 500,000 POA of honest weight, the attacker must lock at least 500,001 POA, slashable and saffron-dear, per forged verdict - no matter how many identities it holds - while an honest voter stakes 500 once.
